priorWholeTuple.completeDEDescription: Die lernende Person kann ausgewählte Rohstoffe der Kunststoffproduktion hinsichtlich Nachhaltigkeit, Umweltschutz und Entsorgung vergleichen und bewerten.
priorWholeTuple.completeENDescription: The learner can compare and evaluate selected raw materials for plastic production in terms of sustainability, environmental protection, and disposal.
primarySourceSpans: HE Q4.2 complete primary context, PDF physical page 50
wholeDemandArgument: The full prerequisite compares selected plastic-production raw materials against sustainability, environmental protection and disposal. The ordinary-looking 4d partner evaluates plastics and metals with analogue/digital sources for sustainable development; the other ordinary partner 2cf is itself unsupported in HE.

The stock compiler marks 4d with HE mapping evidence. Inspection of the actual mapping shows three ancestor mappings, to Chemie, Energie und Nachhaltigkeit, and Q4.2; no individual mapping row targets 4d. Hence the apparently direct evidence is inherited source evidence, not a complete primary clause matched to the whole plastics-and-metals judgment.

The complete HE Q4.2 primary context covers fuel cells, plant-oil fuels, bioethanol, batteries, biodiesel and starch-based plastics/degradation. This does not establish the full canonical 4d partner and does not prove that broad plastic raw-material comparison is necessary for every retained source duty. HE Q2.2 recycling and polymer-production duties may support another narrow source role, but that work is not replaced by an inherited root mapping.

residualFinding.statement: Counterfactual stock closure success through 4d is not a verified primary full-demand anchor. Whole downstream scope and exact original operators must be joined first.

resourceLinks.altText: Zwei gleich geneigte, orange beschichtete Unterlagen zeigen bei gleicher Silikonchemie einen stärker ausgebreiteten ruhenden Tropfen auf einer glatten Oberfläche und einen kompakteren beweglichen Tropfen auf einer strukturierten Oberfläche.
